audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..6].side are flat 'Skill' while content win[3..6] and win[0..2] all already say 'Milio' — the whole chart should read Milio.
audit.why: win[] and whys[] already describe Milio winning every stage; side is the stale placeholder on the back half of the chart.
spikes[] already states a concrete curve: level-2 dive windows on detach, R-vs-R at 6, Moonstone tempo at first item, forcing detaches late.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags four gaps: untargetable dodges burst while attached (already covered by dosFull[0].d), needs-antiheal against her sustain (was buried under a copy-paste-bled dontsFull[2].d), channel-interruptible R (absent — her R is a channel any CC/displacement cancels, and Milio's Q knockup can do it), and on-hit itemization on Q/W (not stated anywhere). Packet also flags zero cooldown-sequencing lines and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all.
audit.why: A reader gets no concrete 'wait for X, then Y' timing and no anti-heal call, despite both being decisive against an enchanter matchup.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with Q's real 6.5s cooldown, the detach-to-cast timing on W, and the Q-knockup-interrupts-R note; dontsFull[2].d rewritten to state the anti-heal need explicitly.

edits.before: Q the rebound through the pair, warm the carry, auto — the burn ledger compounds while the buttons wait.
edits.after: Hold both charges through her poke — spend them on the all-in when she's off her host, not on chip Q pokes.

edits.before: Spending the R on a single stun — the cleanse answers chains; chains wait for it to be gone.
edits.after: Her passive and R sustain through chip — without Grievous Wounds you're racing a heal that never runs out of mana.

edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. It writes your spacing rules. - R Breath of Life is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Yuumi's Q (Prowling Projectile): 6.5s cooldown — step up right after she pokes, before it's back. - You and Me! (W) has no cooldown, but she must detach to Q or E first — punish that window. - Save R Breath of Life for her R (120s) — a channel your Q knockup interrupts.
